payload.name: Class Course Workshop and Group Enrollment Retrieval
payload.description: Use when a question asks what classes, courses, workshops, trainings, or groups a person has joined, taken, attended, or participated in.
content: When asked about classes, courses, workshops, trainings, or groups a person has joined, taken, or participated in, run searches across memory kinds event, plan, preference, and profile; do not restrict to event/plan alone.

Use varied enrollment/participation phrasing such as 'signed up', 'took', 'started', 'attended', 'joined', 'participated', 'involved in', 'workshop', 'course', 'class', and 'group', combined with the person's name or topic.

Merge results across searches and stop once all distinct classes/groups the question asks about are found or one additional targeted search returns no new candidates; do not require the exact word 'class' or 'group' to appear in a memory.

solves: Agent misses classes/courses/workshops/groups when retrieval is anchored on the question's noun phrases and restricted to event/plan memory kinds, even though such memberships may be stored in profile/preference memories and phrased as 'signed up', 'took', 'involved in' or 'workshop'.
